d: Addressing reporters in Coimbatore, MDMK leader Vaiko got into a heated exchange with journalists over viral clips of him pushing someone away while walking alongside a leader. Vaiko launched a sharp attack on the DMK—recalling his past split with the party and alleging political betrayal of figures like Vadivelu—while also criticising the Supreme Court's verdict on lighting a lamp at a stone pillar atop the Tiruparankundram hill as hurting minority sentiments.
